====================================================================================================
Casts of nested types and vectors

Each case runs as CAST. TRY_CAST follows a case only when CAST fails at runtime, to show which rows
become NULL. Where CAST succeeds, TRY_CAST is checked to return the same values and is not listed;
where CAST fails type checking, TRY_CAST is checked to fail it too.
====================================================================================================


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Tuples and arrays

A tuple or an array converts field by field or element by element; a tuple converts only to a tuple
with the same number of fields. TRY_CAST makes each field and element nullable, so only the field or
element that fails is NULL.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


error: 
  --> SQL:1:1
  |
1 | CAST((1, TRUE) AS Tuple(STRING))
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ unable to cast type `Tuple(UInt8, Boolean)` to type `Tuple(String,)`



error: 
  --> SQL:1:1
  |
1 | CAST(('a',) AS Tuple(INT))
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ invalid digit found in string while evaluating function `to_int32('a')` in expr `CAST(tuple('a') AS Tuple(Int32,))`

output         : (NULL,)

checked expr   : CAST<Tuple(Tuple(UInt8, Boolean), UInt8)>(tuple<Tuple(UInt8, Boolean), UInt8>(tuple<UInt8, Boolean>(1_u8, true), 1_u8) AS Tuple(Tuple(Int32, Int32), Int32))
optimized expr : ((1_i32, 1_i32), 1_i32)
output type    : Tuple(Tuple(Int32, Int32), Int32)
output domain  : (({1..=1}, {1..=1}), {1..=1})
output         : ((1, 1), 1)

  |

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Vectors

A string or a JSON array of numbers converts to a vector of the declared dimension.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


ast            : CAST('[1,2,3,4]' AS VECTOR(4))
raw expr       : CAST('[1,2,3,4]' AS Vector(4))
checked expr   : CAST<String>("[1,2,3,4]" AS Vector(4))
optimized expr : [1, 2, 3, 4]
output type    : Vector(4)
output domain  : Undefined
output         : [1, 2, 3, 4]


ast            : CAST(parse_json('[1,2,3,4]') AS VECTOR(4))
raw expr       : CAST(parse_json('[1,2,3,4]') AS Vector(4))
checked expr   : CAST<Variant>(CAST<String>("[1,2,3,4]" AS Variant) AS Vector(4))
optimized expr : [1, 2, 3, 4]
output type    : Vector(4)
output domain  : Undefined
output         : [1, 2, 3, 4]


ast            : CAST(a AS VECTOR(4))
raw expr       : CAST(a::String AS Vector(4))
checked expr   : CAST<String>(a AS Vector(4))
evaluation:
+--------+---------------------------------------+----------------------+
|        | a                                     | Output               |
+--------+---------------------------------------+----------------------+
| Type   | String                                | Vector(4)            |
| Domain | {" [1,2,3,4] "..="[8.1,8.2,8.3,8.4]"} | Unknown              |
| Row 0  | ' [1,2,3,4] '                         | [1, 2, 3, 4]         |
| Row 1  | '[4.5, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5]'                | [4.5, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5] |
| Row 2  | '[8.1,8.2,8.3,8.4]'                   | [8.1, 8.2, 8.3, 8.4] |
+--------+---------------------------------------+----------------------+
evaluation (internal):
+--------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Column | Data                                                                       |
+--------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| a      | Column(StringColumn[ [1,2,3,4] , [4.5, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5], [8.1,8.2,8.3,8.4]]) |
| Output | Float32(([1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 4.5, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3, 8.4], 4)) |
+--------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+


ast            : CAST(parse_json(a) AS VECTOR(4))
raw expr       : CAST(parse_json(a::String) AS Vector(4))
checked expr   : CAST<Variant>(CAST<String>(a AS Variant) AS Vector(4))
evaluation:
+--------+---------------------------------------+----------------------+
|        | a                                     | Output               |
+--------+---------------------------------------+----------------------+
| Type   | String                                | Vector(4)            |
| Domain | {" [1,2,3,4] "..="[8.1,8.2,8.3,8.4]"} | Unknown              |
| Row 0  | ' [1,2,3,4] '                         | [1, 2, 3, 4]         |
| Row 1  | '[4.5, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5]'                | [4.5, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5] |
| Row 2  | '[8.1,8.2,8.3,8.4]'                   | [8.1, 8.2, 8.3, 8.4] |
+--------+---------------------------------------+----------------------+
evaluation (internal):
+--------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Column | Data                                                                       |
+--------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| a      | Column(StringColumn[ [1,2,3,4] , [4.5, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5], [8.1,8.2,8.3,8.4]]) |
| Output | Float32(([1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 4.5, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3, 8.4], 4)) |
+--------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
